properties.description: Over the MCP surface (the service's own tool handlers): a CONTRADICTS drawn through review_relations with alignment "supporting" is stored supporting with its evidence intact, and detect_defects reports no contradiction for it; one drawn with no alignment is still stored opposing and still reported; a value the schema does not allow ("neutral", or a DUPLICATES basis on a CAUSES link) is refused naming the property and its legal values, with nothing written; a property the link's relation does not declare (alignment on CAUSES, optional on BLOCKS) is refused naming what that relation takes; a value that differs from an edge already stored is refused naming create_edge, while the same value reads as already present; and add_decision's related_to carries the same fields. Five of its six cases failed on main c58305ba8 ("unknown field `alignment`").
properties.name: tests/a_contradiction_drawn_as_corroboration_is_stored_supporting.rs
